Subject: Onboarding Redwood as a vendor — required fields & VAT evidence

Hi Evelyn,

We’re finishing the vendor enablement checklist for Redwood and need a couple of pieces before we can activate you in our supplier portal: 

- A completed AP onboarding packet (we prefer PDF).
- Confirmation on what PO fields Redwood requires on inbound POs (eg. order_number, project_code, remit_to details).
- Vendor tax evidence: under EU rules we need either a VAT registration certificate or self-declaration for cross-border services.

Also: please confirm whether Redwood can accept net-30 or whether you require accelerated payment terms tied to volume. Once we have these items, we’ll provision an account and send test POs.

Thanks — I’ll own this on our side.

Best,
Marta Lopez

- Redwood can accept standard net-30 terms for hosted API usage; for Reserved/Dedicated capacity we typically request net-45 on new accounts — happy to discuss.
- We have an EU VAT registration certificate (attached). If you need an EORI or local tax form, let us know which country and we’ll provide it.

Thanks, Evelyn / Marta. A few clarifying items from Finance so Verdant can provision us cleanly: 

1) PO fields: please include these exact field names on the purchase order payload/line level where possible:
   - order_number (string)
   - po_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
   - bill_to.code (customer internal code)
   - remit_to.partner_id (Redwood vendor ID)
   - tax_rate_percent (for VAT reconciliation)
   - project_code (optional)

2) Invoice matching: we’ll do 2-way matching (invoice -> PO) for hosted API usage. For Dedicated capacity invoices include the service period and instance IDs.

3) Remit instructions: Redwood accepts bank transfer (SEPA) and also has an EFT option for US customers — Laura, I pasted our SWIFT/IBAN below for Verdant to load.

SWIFT: RBINUS33XXX
IBAN: GB29 RWBK 6016 1334 5698 45

Marta — is Verdant’s portal able to accept attachments for VAT evidence at vendor profile creation, or do you require the evidence to be uploaded after activation via a separate case?

Best,
Karthik
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Onboarding Redwood as a vendor — required fields & VAT evidence

Hi Evelyn and team — great, that helps. A couple of notes from our side: 

- Our portal supports uploading VAT evidence during initial vendor creation (preferred). Please upload the PDF when you return the signed packet.
- For remit_to.partner_id we use an internal 8-digit vendor code — we will generate that when we create the record and will send it back in the portal confirmation email.
- On payment terms: Verdant policy defaults to net-60 for new vendors; exceptions can be requested by Procurement + Finance. If Redwood needs net-30 please submit a short commercial rationale and a point of contact for credit.

We’ll provision a test vendor record next Tuesday (21 Sep) and push a test PO to the email listed in your packet.

Regards,
Marta
